page_title: COM 1-5 LAZ | Como v Lazio 31/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' 1 - 5 Goal! Manuel Lazzari provides Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 1:5.
90+5' Lazio are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90+3' Nico Paz (Como) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90+1' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

89' Nico Paz (Como) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is coming onto the pitch as Patric cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
86' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Federico Barba (Como) replaces Luca Mazzitelli.
85' It will be a substitution. Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) is ready to enter the pitch as Patrick Cutrone walks off.
81' 1 - 4 Goal! Boulaye Dia slips a clever pass through to Taty Castellanos (Lazio), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and low into the middle of the goal. 1:4.
80' Alberto Cerri (Como) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly wide of the left post.
79' Here is a change. Pedro is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
79' Adam Marusic goes off the pitch and Samuel Gigot (Lazio) comes on.

78' What a big chance! Patrick Cutrone (Como) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
76' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
73' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Alberto Moreno and he is replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).
73' The game has come to an end for Gabriel Strefezza. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alberto Cerri (Como).
71' 1 - 3 Patric (Lazio) headed in a well-placed corner kick. His perfect header goes inside the right post with majestic precision.
71' Pedro (Lazio) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

71' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the left side of the goal but for a magnificent save by Emil Audero. The ball is out of play and Lazio manage to earn a corner.
70' Nico Paz (Como) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals. Lazio win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
69' Alberto Moreno (Como) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
68' Pedro (Lazio) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
66' That will be all from Gustav Isaksen who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
65' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
64' Nico Paz (Como) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
63' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
62' Matthias Braunoder (Como) sees a second yellow card and he can't continue in the game.
61' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
59' Nico Paz (Como) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Luca Pairetto stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
57' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
57' 2:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
56' Patrick Cutrone (Como) is penalised for a foul. Luca Pairetto had a clear view and blows his whistle.

53' 1 - 2 Luca Mazzitelli (Como) is the first to get to a rebound inside the penalty area and his weak, but precise effort finds its way through the defenders into the top right corner, bouncing in off the post.
53' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' What a great touch by Boulaye Dia (Lazio) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
51' A dangerous looking corner kick from Pedro (Lazio) is cleared to safety by the defence.

47' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes just over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
46' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tijjani Noslin will be replaced by Boulaye Dia (Lazio).
46' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Alieu Fadera will be replaced by Lucas Da Cunha (Como).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Matthias Braunoder (Como) is booked.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' It's like he was asking for a caution. Matias Vecino (Lazio) receives a yellow card.
44' The ball spins to Pedro (Lazio) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
43' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' Ivan Provedel leaps to intercept the corner kick from Nico Paz (Como). Como have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' Adam Marusic (Lazio) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emil Audero, who smothers the ball.
40' The linesman signals that Alieu Fadera (Como) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

38' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Alieu Fadera (Como). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
35' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
35' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
33' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
31' 0 - 2 Goal! Nuno Tavares shows great vision to find Pedro (Lazio) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 0:2.
29' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) calmly steps up and smashes the ball into the top left corner.
28' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
27' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Lazio!
26' Referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lazio. Let’s see what happens!
25' Surely that's handball by one of the Como players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
25' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

24' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. The ball is out of play. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner.
21' A player from Lazio commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
17' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
15' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Matthias Braunoder, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
13' The ball is behind the sideline. Alberto Moreno (Como) takes a throw-in.
12' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
7' Patrick Cutrone (Como) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
6' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
4' Adam Marusic (Lazio) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
2' Lazio keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' The first half has started.
Como will kick the game off.
Luca Pairetto got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
